Runtime vendor assets
=====================

These files are loaded by the app at runtime so the local editor does not depend on CDN requests.

- Font Awesome 6.5.1: `fontawesome/` (`all.min.css` plus solid, regular and brands webfonts)
- MediaPipe Face Mesh 0.4.1633559619: `mediapipe/face_mesh/`
- Mediabunny 1.49.0: `mediabunny/`

Keep license files with each vendored package when updating.
